name: Siren Head
description: Siren Head is a fictional horror entity created by Canadian artist Trevor Henderson in 2018 — a skeletal 40-foot-tall humanoid with two mechanical sirens in place of a head — that spread virally through internet horror communities and inspired games, videos, and fan works before being misidentified by some users as a real cryptid.

aliases.name: Sirenhead
aliases.meaning: Common one-word spelling used by fans and media

origin: A fictional entity with no real-world geographic range. In its fictional framing, depicted in rural North American settings.
